messages:
elaine: quick PSA — during the weekly access-sweep I noticed a small spike of admin grants originating from the staging cleanup job. not a full outage but something smells off :nose: 
omar: can you paste the raw event ids?
elaine: pasted below, anonymized 
>>> `grant_id: 0x8f3a2, actor: infra-svc, target_role: admin, reason: automated-sweep, env: staging, ts: 2026-03-18T14:02:12Z`
devon: hmm infra-svc should only be issuing `svc-maintainer` in staging, not `admin`. did we recently update the role-mapping for the sweeper lambda?
jules: I pushed a change last week to the sweep job — it reads role mappings from secrets/kms/role-map. I did a quick diff, the mapping is unchanged in git but the KMS secret version rotated on the 17th.
elaine: sec-bot shows KMS rotate event around the same time: `kms-rotate evt id 0x7b1e`. sec-bot: KMS rotation noted, secret version bumped, access policy unchanged.
sec-bot: AccessScan completed: found 12 grants by infra-svc to high-priv roles in staging within 2h window. score: medium. (see /accessscan/2026-03-18/3632)
omar: ok action items: 1) block new grants from infra-svc until we confirm mapping 2) roll back last deploy of sweep job if it changed behavior 3) postmortem entry and 4) notify oncall
oncall-sre: I'm online, can block using `authz block-service infra-svc --env staging` and monitor.
devon: confirm command and I'll coordinate rollback.
oncall-sre: running: ```bash
authz block-service infra-svc --env staging --reason "suspected mis-mapping after KMS rotate"
# returns job 8421 queued
```
elaine: good. also let's add a quick audit-hook to record which KMS secret version was used when the job resolved roles. maybe we missed version pinning.
jules: agree — will add `KMS_SECRET_VERSION` env guard in the job and a fallback that errors instead of defaulting to admin. small snippet I plan to add: ```yaml
- name: fetch-role-map
  run: |
    role_map=$(kms-get secrets/kms/role-map --version $KMS_SECRET_VERSION) || exit 1
```
devon: sounds good. then we should run a targeted least-privilege audit for services with elevated grants in the last 30d. sec-bot: queueing LD-Audit job for infra-svc and related principals.
sec-bot: LD-Audit queued: job id 90012. Expected runtime 25m. Will report anomalies > 1 privilege tier difference.
elaine: for the immediate cleanup, can we auto-revoke the specific admin grants in staging and leave evidence? make it reversible.
omar: yes — proposed safe-revoke: `authz revoke --grant 0x8f3a2 --reason "auto cleanup - suspected mapping" --dry-run` then actual revoke after 15m.
oncall-sre: did dry-run: shows targets: 3 tokens, 1 service principal. no user accounts. proceeding to revoke in 15m window.
jules: I'm creating a short incident doc in the security board with links to audit logs and KMS rotate events. will include remediation checklist and owners.
devon: follow-up: add an alert rule to compare KMS secret versions read by jobs vs the version listed in the deployment manifest. if mismatch, fail the job and send to eng-oncall.
elaine: thanks all. postmortem owner is jules, mitigation owner is oncall-sre for the block, devon for the audit, omar for revoke script. cc @product-security for visibility. :white_check_mark:
